claim: Les Morainières is a Michelin-starred restaurant in Jongieux, Savoie, in the Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes region.
quote: Les Morainières – Jongieux - a MICHELIN Guide Restaurant

claim: The restaurant sits at 1400 route de Marestel, 73170 Jongieux, perched on the Marestel hillside above the Rhône.

La Maison des Morainières is the Arnoults' own 6-room guesthouse with herb-named rooms (35-45 m²), heated outdoor pool, chef-prepared breakfast and a driver shuttling guests to and from the restaurant.
quote: 6 spacious rooms (35-45 m²)… named after plants: Marjolaine, Mélisse, Oxalys, Reine des Prés, Pimprenelle, and Achillée… A daily shuttle transports guests between the two locations for lunch and dinner service.

claim: La Maison des Morainières is located at 68 route du Grand Bois in Saint-Pierre-de-Curtille; rates range from €250-320 per double room.
quote: 68 route du Grand Bois in Saint Pierre de Curtille… Rates range from 250-320€ for one or two people

claim: Château de La Mar combines a restored château with a 6-hectare Marestel vineyard producing 4 white + 2 red cuvées under HV3 certification; on-site spa, pool, French garden and La Table 1625 restaurant.
quote: 6 hectares au cœur du coteau Marestel… 4 cuvées de blanc 100% Marestel et 2 cuvées de rouge… Spa du Château… La Table 1625

claim: Château de La Mar is a 17th-century residence with 5 rooms including four suites; doubles €220-300 with breakfast included.
quote: The Château de la Mar is a 17th-century residence entirely refurbished… 5 rooms with 5 rooms including four suites. Double rooms range from €220 to €300, with breakfast included.

claim: Reviewers single out Château de La Mar's breakfast, the in-room jetted tub, and the vineyard tastings; restored about ten years ago.
quote: beautiful castle in the middle of the vineyards, restored 10 years ago… outstanding breakfast… the best jetted tub… fantastic wines made right there.

claim: Domaine Carrel & Senger is an independent Marestel wine estate with 4 guest rooms decorated to the four vine seasons.
quote: 4 chambres d'hôtes spacieuses déclinées aux couleurs des 4 saisons qui rythment la vie de la vigne… au cœur du coteau de Marestel

claim: Carrel & Senger's 4 air-conditioned rooms sit above the chai with private bathrooms and 180×200 beds; address 3387 route des Vignobles, 73170 Jongieux.
quote: 4 chambres d'hôtes haut de gamme pour 2 personnes chacune avec salle d'eau privative, au 1er étage, au dessus du chai… 1 lit 2 personnes 180x200 cm… climatisation

claim: Les Chambres du Cru at Domaine Edmond Jacquin & Fils offers 3 rooms named Pinot, Mondeuse and Gamay at 390 m altitude on the GR9 / Compostela path, with local-product breakfast and on-request tasting.
quote: 3 rooms… Pinot, Mondeuse, and Gamay… Located directly along the GR9 hiking trail (Santiago de Compostela route)… 390 meters altitude overlooking vineyards and the Rhône Valley

claim: Le Doux Nid in Chanaz occupies an 18th-century former coaching inn at 501 route du canal with themed rooms, Le Relais Gourmand restaurant and unlicensed boat rental.
quote: an 18th-century former coaching inn… five themed rooms… 501 route du canal - 73310 Chanaz… La Petite Évasion boat rental (no license required)

claim: Le Doux Nid has nine charming rooms across two historic properties on the canal, with breakfast on the waterside patio; neighbouring Domaine des Îles offers stilt bungalows, i-lofts, bohemian caravans and safari tents.
quote: Nine charming guest rooms across two historic properties—one in a restored coaching inn… Domaine des Îles: Unique glamping… îlots sur pilotis, i-lofts, bohemian caravans, and safari tents

claim: Logis Hôtel du Fer à Cheval is a 12-room 2-star hotel in medieval Yenne on the St-Jacques-de-Compostelle route, with a Savoyard restaurant on site.
quote: Yenne (an ancient medieval city) on the route of St-Jacques-de-Compostelle, near the GR9 and ViaRhôna, with 12 rooms… cuisine that is generous, authentic, and inspired by Savoyard regional specialties

claim: Le Fer à Cheval is open seven days a week from 1 April to 30 October, i.e. closed in winter.
quote: The property is open 7 days a week from April 1st to October 30th.

claim: Château Brachet in Grésy-sur-Aix is the 19th-century mansion of Doctor Brachet ('Le Médecin des Rois'), eco-renovated and reopened early 2021, with 15 rooms, La Table du Château gastronomic restaurant and an 18 m outdoor pool in a 6-hectare park.
quote: the residence of Doctor Brachet, known as 'the Doctor of Kings'… eco-renovation and reopened in early 2021… 15 rooms and suites… La Table du Château… 18-meter outdoor swimming pool… 6 hectares of parkland

claim: Aix-les-Bains to Jongieux by road is approximately 24 km.
Yenne to Jongieux is 6.6 km, roughly 8 minutes by car.
Jongieux to Chanaz is 9.9 km, roughly 12 minutes by car.
Aix-les-Bains-based taxi companies cover Jongieux and Savoie with 24/7 service and online or phone reservation.
quote: Taxi Aix Les Bains : Taxi Fred & Angel | 06 26 04 45 71… Service disponible 24h/24 et 7j/7
